source.dataset: Powertech Labs SAE J2601 MC Default bench traces
source.source_role: public consumed development material; not a fresh holdout
boundary_inputs: published inlet-gas temperature trace used as delivery thermal boundary

claim_boundary: This is a bounded PCV/precooler/hose/vehicle-tank diagnostic. It is not independent full-station validation, SAE conformance, field-safety evidence, or an IJHE full digital-twin performance claim.
frozen_holdout_effect: none; the previously frozen 0/8 external result remains unchanged

runs.name: safety-aware baseline
runs.stop_reason: five of eight cases stopped at the 85°C gas-temperature limit
runs.interpretation: Pressure and temperature error can look bounded over the simulated prefix, but the model covers only part of the observed fill in several cases. It must not be treated as a complete fill validation.

runs.name: raised-temperature-limit sensitivity
runs.stop_reason: controller temperature stop removed as a diagnostic counterfactual
runs.interpretation: Coverage reaches the full observed duration, but aggregate pressure, temperature, and SOC errors worsen and no case meets the joint screen. The raised limit is not an allowable operating setting.

what_is_supported: partial-station replay with an explicitly measured/published source-pressure boundary
separate diagnosis of premature safety termination versus thermal/flow mismatch
prioritisation of source-boundary, heat-transfer, and controller-state measurements
what_is_not_supported: safety-limit relaxation based on this sensitivity
next_data_priority: synchronised dispenser inlet pressure, inlet temperature and mass flow
precooler outlet temperature and controller/valve state
vehicle tank pressure/temperature/SOC on the same clock
declared sensor units, calibration and stop-event semantics
